blocks.text: When I sat down to write my initial movie review of Zach Cregger’s ‘Resident Evil’ (2026), I knew the film was something extraordinary. Writing from the perspective of a longtime gamer and collector, I praised its relentless pacing, its atmospheric tension, and its ability to bridge the gap between a hardcore gamer’s fantasy and a casual moviegoer’s dream. But as any true cinema aficionado knows, the real test of a modern horror film is how well it holds up when the initial shock wears off.
